title: Unnamed Foundation Agent 003
summary: Unnamed Foundation Agent 003 is a Seeker working for the Huntik Foundation. He is a trained field operative and often works with two other unnamed agents, 001 and 002.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
This Foundation agent and some other field operatives arrested [[Rassimov]] outside the [[Tomb of Tutankhamun]] and contained his Amulets in a [[Reliquary]]. He and the other agents then drove him away to be taken into custody. However their land rovers were attacked by [[Harrison Fears]] and [[Jericho]], freeing Rassimov and defeating the agents. {{Source|Rassimov's Secret}}

This agent later travelled to the [[Spiral Mark]] with the rest of the [[Huntik Foundation]] and was seen fighting against the [[Silent Soldiers]] in the final battle. {{source|Lok and the Betrayer}} Following the defeat of [[the Betrayer]], he  and several other Foundation members were stationed at the Spiral Mark as they tried to make sense of the data. {{source|Dante's Return}}

full_text:
Unnamed Foundation Agent 003 is a Seeker working for the Huntik Foundation. He is a trained field operative and often works with two other unnamed agents, 001 and 002. 

== History ==
This Foundation agent and some other field operatives arrested Rassimov outside the Tomb of Tutankhamun and contained his Amulets in a Reliquary. He and the other agents then drove him away to be taken into custody. However their land rovers were attacked by Harrison Fears and Jericho, freeing Rassimov and defeating the agents. [Rassimov's Secret]

This agent later travelled to the Spiral Mark with the rest of the Huntik Foundation and was seen fighting against the Silent Soldiers in the final battle. [Lok and the Betrayer] Following the defeat of the Betrayer, he and several other Foundation members were stationed at the Spiral Mark as they tried to make sense of the data. [Dante's Return]

== Abilities ==
Like most Foundation field operatives, this agent is trained in physical combat and can rely on the standard Huntik Foundation powers.
